description: Entity collapse: S(a|name,ids) = 10*id + 3*exact + 1.5*loose, veto identifier_conflict. theta=1 (need some positive evidence), delta=0.5 (a clear winner merges; a true tie between weak candidates parks -> create-new, never a blind merge). Reproduces the layered resolver: id-first (L0.5), exact name (L1), token-superset loose (L2.5), conflict veto.
